summary: The chaos experiments exposed critical single‑replica weaknesses across the checkout path, causing significant error spikes and service unavailability. All affected services recovered within seconds, but the lack of PDB/HPA left them vulnerable to repeated outages. Implementing replicas for cartservice and productcatalogservice mitigated the most severe failures, while other services still require architectural changes.

findings.title: Productcatalogservice pod kill
findings.what_happened: Killing the sole productcatalogservice pod caused 54.5% error rate and 73 ms p95 latency during the fault, but the service recovered in 9.98 s.
findings.root_cause: The service had no PDB or HPA and a single replica, so the pod kill left no fallback. Evidence: "frontend: {\"error\":\"could not retrieve product: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = \"transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 10.96.223.78:3550: connect: connection refused\"\""
findings.fix: Add a second replica and enable a PDB to prevent single‑point failures. The remediation plan for cartservice demonstrates the expected improvement.

findings.title: Cartservice pod kill
findings.what_happened: Killing the sole cartservice pod raised error rate to 45.2% and p95 latency to 2,300 ms, but the service recovered in 56.2 s.
findings.root_cause: Single‑replica without PDB/HPA caused a complete outage. Evidence: "frontend: {\"error\":\"could not retrieve cart: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = \"transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 10.96.109.18:7070: connect: connection refused\"\""
findings.fix: Increase replicas to 2 and add a PDB. The remediation increased the score to 95 and eliminated the error spike.

findings.title: Currencyservice pod kill
findings.what_happened: Killing the single currencyservice pod caused a 16.3% error rate and 120 ms p95 latency, recovering in 24.6 s.
findings.root_cause: No redundancy for currencyservice left the checkout flow unable to convert prices. Evidence: "frontend: {\"error\":\"could not retrieve currencies: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = \"transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 10.96.54.127:7000: connect: connection refused\"\""
findings.fix: No fix was applied; a future patch should add replicas or a PDB.

findings.title: Paymentservice pod kill
findings.what_happened: Killing the sole paymentservice pod raised error rate to 4.8% and kept p95 latency at 170 ms, recovering in 1.36 s.
findings.root_cause: Single‑replica without PDB/HPA caused payment failures. Evidence: "frontend: {\"error\":\"failed to complete the order: rpc error: code = Internal desc = failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = \"transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 10.96.220.189:50051: connect: connection refused\"\""
findings.fix: No fix was applied; adding replicas or a PDB would eliminate the outage.
